Bugbear Stalker

Low-threat on paper, high-chaos at the table: Bugbear Stalker.

AC 15 and HP 65 mean it can take a few hits while executing its plan. With a Stealth bonus of +6, it often surprises parties, making the first move count. The Order of Combat
